note: Single source of the orchestrator stages (python3 -m emet.orchestrate); described in ORCHESTRATOR.md. {s} = topic, {D} = search folder data/searches/<topic>-<date>, {S} = {D}/screening.

stages.do: Write the protocol and the screening instructions, then commit them alone before any query.
Protocol queries (python3 -m emet.search_pubmed, python3 -m emet.search_sources), Consensus (one broad search), retraction query; python3 -m emet.pubmed_cache.
Batches of ~100 records (title + abstract), one single reviewer per batch, abstract screening rules, doubt = include; retained records join abstract screening.
Independent reviewers A and B on the titles-chunk-*.tsv batches.
Reviewers A and B on abstracts-chunk-*.tsv, agreement (python3 -m emet.screening agreement {s} abstracts), adjudication of disagreements (agents/arbitration.md).
Reviewers A and B on the eligibility/<id>.txt files, instructions eligibility-instructions-{s}.md, agreement, adjudication.
A on all studies, B on the double_extraction_coverage share of the profile + critical outcomes; adjudication of disagreeing fields; risk of bias in the same pass (agents/risk-of-bias.md).

stages.run: python3 -m emet.effects check {s} && python3 -m emet.effects compare {s}
stages.do: Batches per randomised trial (effects/lot-A-*.json, lot-B-*.json): A all outcomes, B critical outcomes; check (verbatim quotes), compare, adjudication of disagreements (effects-arbitration.json), then python3 -m emet.effects final {s}.
Two independent reviewers, adjudication of disagreeing domains.
Page data, template, infographic; workspace publication command ({publish}).
One verifier per batch in batches/, then python3 -m emet.verify_claims check {s}; adjudication of blocking pairs; correction, then re-verification of the modified claims only.
Exchange format v0.8: schema, links between entities, PRISMA identities; an error blocks publication.

Reviewer A on all studies, reviewer B on the double_extraction_coverage share of the profile: interests/studies/<study>.txt and the eligibility files of its reports; check; adjudication of the disagreeing studies (study-declarations-arbitration.json).

Independent reviewers A and B on each interests/author-batches/batch-*.json (one output file per reviewer, all batches merged); check; adjudication of disagreements (author-assessment-arbitration.json), cautious decision not_retained.

stages.run: python3 -m emet.interests final {s} && python3 -m emet.migrate_review {s} && python3 -m emet.check_review {s}
stages.do: Then rerun the workspace publication command ({publish}) so that the badges and the section are rendered.
